notes: φιλάργυροι → 'lovers of money' headed on 'lovers': ἀργυρ- is the incorporated element and φιλ- the core, as rule 66 decides καρποφοροῦντες → 'bearing fruit'. Heading on 'money' is the competing reading.
'at' stays inside the verb's unit, ἐξεμυκτήριζον governing an accusative that has no case for an English preposition to realize (rule 106).
